limitations.note: The patch fixed the state encoding but also changed four-state simulation behavior: an unknown first bit in idle previously took the failure branch, whereas the merged ternary can put unknown bits into the next state.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before simulation, so the agent had to submit the testbench again.

limitations.quote: Passed all 4096 ordered group pairs and asynchronous reset checks
limitations.note: Exhaustively testing every pair was more than the encoding fix needed, since a few directed cases could verify that a rejected group pulses at bit six and leaves the next group aligned.
